Name: Abimelech, Son of Abiathar
Summary: Son of Abiathar and priest under David, with Zadok.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 18:16: Son of Abiathar and priest under David, with Zadok.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Abimelech stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
